mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over the prior quarter is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding future equity value.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% in the prior quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >70% of similar rising-rate regimes, or IC > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5% for two consecutive months, wage growth accelerates and consumer confidence rises, both of which are associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are negative in >50% of such labor market tightening episodes, or IC < -0.1 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in industrial production of over 3% followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals a bottom in supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month < -3% then > 0% in the following month
failure_condition: No significant return advantage in 20 days after such bottoms, or IC < 0.05 over 6-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of new home sales to prior month's sales turns positive after two consecutive negative months, it indicates a recovery in the housing market, which is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 month-over-month crosses above 0 after two negative months
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >40% of such recoveries, or IC < -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2% for three months are associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as markets anticipate future inflation pressures.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly > 0.2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such inflation trends, or IC > 0.1 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A one-standard-deviation increase in unemployment benefits (indirect proxy via UNRATE falling below 5%) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor market participation boosts risk sentiment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% for one month
regime_hint: labor benefit expansion or low-participation regime
failure_condition: No significant return advantage in 60 days, or IC < 0.05 over 6-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail sales (proxy via HOUST) exceeding 2% suggests resilient consumer demand, predicting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST month-over-month > 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of such demand cycles, or IC < -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to supply-side expansion (indicated by INDPRO > 110 and RSAFS > 400,000) is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates production capacity growth.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns in such regimes, or IC < 0.05 over 12-month windows.
